answer: Give every newcomer custody of one unique shard of the public archive, like a lotus petal in a shared delta: no two identities hold the same piece. Strangers issue random retrievability challenges, asking for one chunk at an unpredictable moment, and the holder must return the exact bytes within seconds. A farm running many names from one store cannot answer distinct shards at once, and matching failures collapse into a single voice. Lost shards or slow answers decay standing, while a comet-fast correct reply over many seasons proves a real, separate custodian.
